description: 1. The agent reads `legacy_exports/2022_Q2/new_office_ip_candidates.csv` to extract all candidate IPs. 2. The agent reads `network_planning/office_deployments/london/subnet_planning_brief.txt` to identify the subnet (10.0.1.0/24) and range (10.0.1.1 to 10.0.1.100). 3. For each candidate IP, the agent runs `scripts/script.sh validate <ip>` — a non-trivial step since it must parse the CSV and call validate per IP, correctly identifying 11 valid IPs and 4 invalid ones (10.0.1.300, 999.1.1.1, 10.0.1.abc, 10.0.1.-1). 4. The agent runs `scripts/script.sh subnet 10.0.1.0/24` (PROPRIETARY TRAP: must pass full CIDR notation, not just an IP) to obtain network/broadcast/netmask/host count details. 5. The agent runs `scripts/script.sh range 10.0.1.1 10.0.1.100` (PROPRIETARY TRAP: two separate positional arguments, not a hyphenated string) to enumerate all 100 IPs in the range. 6. All results are consolidated into `network_audit.json` at the workspace root with structured sections for validated IPs, invalid IPs, subnet details, and range enumeration.
